Closed Meeting Summary
notes:
Mayor Guthrie called the open meeting to order (12:54 p.m.).
Mayor Guthrie spoke regarding the matters discussed in closed session and identified the following:
384 Crawley Road - Ontario Land Tribunal Update

motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act section 239(2)(e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board; and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act section 239(2)(e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board; and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.

motions.text: That Council authorizes and directs the General Manager of Planning and Building Services, in consultation with the General Manager of Engineering and Transportation Services and the City Solicitor, to approve a conditional site plan for Phase 0 of an industrial development at 384 Crawley Road, and to authorize tree removal on the site as part of conditional approval.

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned (12:56 p.m.).
